title: Show which two-index pivots keep the narrow bandwidth
body:
## Summary
- An invertible prefix of a bandwidth-`b` matrix has Schur bandwidth at most `b`. Every prefix of the 7 by 7 witness, and of a generic in-band matrix, stays within bandwidth 2.
- The adjacent pair `{2,3}` fills bandwidth 3, and the split pair `{2,4}` fills bandwidth 4. Their inverses equal the complementary blocks of the original inverse and remain inside the Neumann bounds `2` and `10`.
- The selected κ is unchanged.
